notes: faster multi-lane training: less host/device waiting, split count reads, multi-tensor gradient clipping and joined attention windows on by default. about 17% more tokens/s in the measured soma-1b H100 setup (32.8k to 38.4k); not a general hardware guarantee. one lane retains the single-stream read exactly. checkpointed training also preserves the full joined window. checkpoint format unchanged; opens earlier somatic core checkpoints.
